name: stream-json
description: Inert stand-in for stream-json. google-ads-api requires it at load time for its report-streaming helpers (reportStream / reportStreamRaw), which this service never calls. Every published stream-json 1.x carries open advisories and 3.x is an incompatible ESM rewrite, so the real package is not installed. stream-chain stays: google-ads-api requires it directly at load time.
